steps.title: Configure Gradle build script and app package identity
steps.description: Set compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, namespace com.bgtubeplayer.app, and declare NanoHTTPD dependency in build.gradle.

steps.title: Configure AndroidManifest for permissions and components
steps.description: Declare INTERNET, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK permissions and register MainActivity, HistoryActivity, and BackgroundAudioService.

steps.title: Define design theme, colors, and string resources
steps.description: Configure dark YouTube theme palette, paywall messaging, and strings for media controls and watch history.

steps.title: Create vector drawables and card background assets
steps.description: Design rounded buttons, card containers, and vector graphics for playback and navigation controls.

steps.title: Implement TrialPaywallManager for access and device status checks
steps.description: Develop TrialPaywallManager to handle device ID retrieval, worker server authorization checks, and cached trial expiry validation.

steps.title: Create watch history data model and SQLite database manager
steps.description: Implement HistoryItem data class and HistoryDbHelper SQLite database manager for tracking user video playback.

steps.title: Implement custom HistoryAdapter and item layout
steps.description: Build item_history.xml layout and HistoryAdapter to render video title, URL, and deletion trigger in a ListView.

steps.title: Construct main player layout and full-screen paywall overlay
steps.description: Build activity_main.xml layout containing browser controls, progress indicators, WebView frame, and paywall lock container.

steps.title: Design watch history activity layout and controller
steps.description: Create activity_history.xml and implement HistoryActivity to let users inspect and clear saved video playback history.

steps.title: Build BackgroundAudioService for media playback and notification handling
steps.description: Implement foreground media service with WakeLock management, AudioManager focus checks, and notification transport controls.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity web browser engine and trial guard system
steps.description: Configure WebView settings, JavaScript bridge, background audio playback injection, and lock overlay lifecycle listeners.

steps.title: Building BG Tube Player
steps.description: Compile and assemble the final binary for BG Tube Player.
